# How to Fish Hub

> Independent fan guide for the Steam game "How to Fish" (App 4001890, Dazed Games).
> Despite the name it is a physics first-person game: catch, kill and sell creatures
> for money, upgrade gear, fight bosses, progress across islands. Released 2026-08-20,
> $7.99, Windows only, 1-4 player online co-op, 28 Steam achievements.

## Guides
- [Full Fish List](https://howtofishthegame.com/fish-list/): all 49 creatures by bait/lure tier, with a caught tracker
- [Bosses](https://howtofishthegame.com/bosses/): island bosses, the bait that lures them, and how to beat each
- [All 28 Achievements](https://howtofishthegame.com/achievements/): exact unlock steps and global unlock rates
- [Co-op](https://howtofishthegame.com/multiplayer/): invite friends, player count, crossplay status, lobby fixes
- [Controls](https://howtofishthegame.com/controls/): keybinds, how to sell fish, controller support
- [Beginner Guide](https://howtofishthegame.com/beginner-guide/): core loop, money tips, first upgrades
- [FAQ](https://howtofishthegame.com/faq/): console/crossplay/price/length answers
- [Patch Notes](https://howtofishthegame.com/updates/): version tracking
- [Fixes & Errors](https://howtofishthegame.com/fixes/): Steam Error 51, crashes, low FPS

## Notes
- Not affiliated with Dazed Games, Valve, or Steam.
- Unverified data (weapon prices, how-long-to-beat, per-fish values) is intentionally omitted.
